name: Artemis 567885 language benchmark, protocol v2
benchmark_status: development benchmark (test scores of this corpus have already been viewed); a separate untouched set is needed for confirmation
matched: same corpus, seed-determined window shuffle and batch order, 5000 optimizer steps, batch 16 x 128, Adam lr 1e-3, clip 1.0, validation every 1000 steps plus untrained model; checkpoint selected on validation bpb only; test scored once after selection
routing: dropless (capacity_mode=none) in training and evaluation; dropped assignments expected 0 in both
aux_loss: added to training loss with weight 0.01 (MoE arms); excluded from all reported bpb
reporting: per-seed val/test bpb, selected checkpoint step, training seconds, bytes processed, total and active parameters, routing load/entropy/aux/drops kept separate from bpb; paired differences by seed; three seeds = preliminary evidence
rule: protocol unchanged once runs start; failed or interrupted runs stay in runs_v2/ledger.jsonl and on disk
